liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Scarlet Begonias** (3 reviews): Contains a single digital glitch in the soundboard; The electric Scarlet>Fire is singled out as a standout moment in an otherwise unremarkable show [11][15][20]
- **Truckin'** (2 reviews): Reviewer calls this Truckin' one of the best ever, with great energy; One of the best rocked-out Truckin's the reviewer has heard, an all-timer [19][22]
- **Dancing in the Streets** (1 review): The jam going from Dancin' into Franklin's is intense, with Brent playing synth in a Herbie Hancock style [14]
- **Franklin's Tower** (1 review): Very noodly, energetic Franklin's at the end of set one, with moments resembling Cape Cod or Rochester shows from fall [16]
- **Deal** (1 review): Rippin' but somewhat truncated Deal, preceded by Looks Like Rain, which Bobby is deeply into [16]

## Setlist highlights

- ***Audience only**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [23]

## The recordings

- **gd1979-12-10.126986.mtx.dusborne.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 22 songs; 161 min; rated 4.83/5 by 6 [1]
- **gd79-12-10.sbd.ststephen.3371.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 22 songs; 158 min; rated 3.27/5 by 11 [2]. Said about its sound: Sound quality is very mediocre across both sets, with one isolated digital glitch during Scarlet Begonias; Sound is not top grade, but the reviewer finds it acceptable given the music; First set sound is decent with good peaks; second set sound is the worst [11][14][20]
- **gd1979-12-10.aud.andrewf.76498.sbeok.flac16**: audience recording; 23 songs; 152 min; rated 4/5 by 2 [3]. Said about its sound: Audience recording is muddied by hiss and background noise, though the performance seems good [17]
- **gd1979-12-10.165179.sbd.anon.gems.flac1644**: soundboard; 21 songs; 165 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [4]. Said about its sound: Brief digital crackles are present in Space [4]
- **gd1979-12-10.sbd.ststephen.tetzeli.fix-3371.34938.reflac.flac16**: soundboard; 21 songs; 157 min; rated 3/5 by 1 [5]. Said about its sound: Right channel is reduced from 1:40 to 2:00 in Franklin's; Scarlet-Fire patch is not pitch-adjusted or crossfaded [5]
- **gd1979-12-10.165876.sbd.anon.gems.v3.flac16**: soundboard; 21 songs; 165 min [6]. Said about its sound: Repeated patch in Fire on the Mountain and distortion in Space have been fixed [6]
- **gd1979-12-10.nak700-minches.77331.flac16**: source not stated; 21 songs; 154 min; rated 3/5 by 4 [10]. Said about its sound: Recording is very good with prominent, rumbling Lesh bass; suggested to play loud on big speakers [22]

## Around the show

- Second set exists only as audience recording, despite the strong setlist [16]
- Brent and Bobby trade off with each other throughout the show [18]
- Despite a strong setlist, the show is seen as getting lost among many better shows [15]
- Rest of the show does not reach the Truckin' level; it has an off-kilter, shifty vibe [22]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1979-12-10.126986.mtx.dusborne.flac16**: transferred by Matrix by Dave Usborne; source: 2 Source Matrix by dusborne; Soundboard (shnid:34938) Set 1 SBD>Cm>Reel>Dat>CD>EAC>SHN; Set 2 SBD>Cm>?>Dat>CD>EAC>SHN; Fix of shnid 3371 and Audience… [1]
- **gd79-12-10.sbd.ststephen.3371.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [2]
- **gd1979-12-10.aud.andrewf.76498.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Unknown; transferred by Andrew F.; source: AUD of unknown lineage [3]. Also: Reviewer says this is one of few circulating sources, matching an old analog cassette they wore out [19]
- **gd1979-12-10.165179.sbd.anon.gems.flac1644**: transferred by Mastered by Jim Blackwood Speed/pitch adjusted by Jason Chastain Track, FLAC, and pack by Steve Gravel; source: SBD Cassette Master > DAT > AIF via Anon [4]
- **gd1979-12-10.sbd.ststephen.tetzeli.fix-3371.34938.reflac.flac16**: transferred by St Stephen and Bill Tetzeli [5]. Also: Soundboard fix of source 3371; drums tracks merged for seamless second set, though a cut remains 3.5 seconds in [5]
- **gd1979-12-10.165876.sbd.anon.gems.v3.flac16**: taped by via Anon; transferred by Mastered by Jim Blackwood Speed/pitch adjusted by Jason Chastain Minor repairs, track, FLAC, and pack by Steve Gravel; source: SBD Cassette Master > DAT > AIF [6]. Also: Version 3 replaces earlier source IDs, with a new file set and small fixes throughout [6]
- **gd1979-12-10.nak700-minches.77331.flac16**: taped by Unknown; transferred by David Minches; source: Nak 700s>Sony TC-D5 [10]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Marsia Tunis Grateful Dead: [1979-12-11 Soldiers' and Sailors' Memorial Hall, Kansas City, KS, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1979-12-11-soldiers-and-sailors-memorial-hall-kansas-city-ks-usa/) [26]
- Poster by Marsia Tunis Grateful Dead: [1979-12-10 Soldiers' and Sailors' Memorial Hall, Kansas City, KS, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1979-12-10-soldiers-and-sailors-memorial-hall-kansas-city-ks-usa/) [27]
